# WHY. All three tables rest on ScreenSpot-v2 alone. A one-benchmark ablation
# cannot separate "this term matters" from "this term matters on this benchmark",
# and ScreenSpot-Pro is the harder, higher-resolution counterpart where coverage
# and layout priors should matter more, not less. Adding it turns each table from
# a single observation into a two-point trend, which is what makes a component
# ANCHORS (recovered by matching the published SSPro averages to their runs):

# thing, so each delta is read against a twin launched from this same queue.
